feedback_or_evaluation_path: Continuous monitoring of piston_zdd_out, oleo_compression, and tire_deflection
Post-processing of time-series data to extract peak acceleration and max stroke
Evaluation of rebound decay and stable ground support recovery

physical_scenario_drivers.intent: Boundary condition changes from supported to free-fall. Physical evidence through release_force, y_s, y_u, v_s, v_u.
Boundary condition changes from airborne to ground contact constraint. Physical evidence through ground_height, y_u, tire_deflection.

scenario_event_mapping.EVT_DESCENT_START: release_force drops to 0, gravity becomes the sole vertical force on the equivalent mass
scenario_event_mapping.EVT_TOUCHDOWN: ground_height constraint activates, tire_deflection > 0, ground reaction force applies

event_timing.inheritance_rules: Physical model stages inherit only physical_scenario_time, scenario events, variables, subsystem roles, information flow, control goals, and expected physical response. They must not inherit SystemModel entry_hold_time/statehold values as physical durations.

scenario_event_schedule.physical_driver: logical marker for release/drop-test start; physical_reference_time_s=0.0; physical evidence through release_force, y_s, y_u, v_s, v_u
logical marker for ground contact start; physical_reference_time_s=0.23; physical evidence through ground_height, y_u, tire_deflection

expected_physical_response.qualitative_direction: Tire deflection and force rise after touchdown. Oleo compression increases. Damping force follows compression speed during impact. Piston rod vertical acceleration peaks are captured for positive peak limit verification.
expected_physical_response.feedback_compensation_evaluation_intent: Identify rebound and settling only after physical trace shows reversal/decay behavior. Evaluate optimization parameters: MLG Wheel Mass, Tire Stiffness Approximation, Forces Oleo Damping Coefficient, MLG Oleo V^2 Damping Coefficient.

control_objectives: Ensure logical events trigger correct physical boundary condition changes and state transitions.
Maintain strict separation between logical scenario scheduling and physical response timing.
Provide clear inheritance intent for physical model boundary conditions and event markers.
Verify vertical shock acceleration, piston rod acceleration positive peak less than 20 m/s^2, compression stroke, bottoming prevention, and post-impact stability.
information_flow_mapping: PhysicalScenarioClock broadcasts time triggers to switch boundary conditions.
ReleaseFixtureActuator sends release_force signal to AirframeMassDynamics to dictate external vertical load.
GroundConstraintEnforcer sends ground_height constraint to TireContactDynamics to trigger tire_deflection calculation.
TireContactDynamics transmits tire_force through WheelAxleAndSlidingTube to OleoGasSpringDynamics.
OleoGasSpringDynamics provides oleo_compression_speed to HydraulicDamperDynamics to drive damping_force calculation.
SensorAndTelemetrySystem streams piston_zdd_out, y_s, y_u, and other signals to DataLogger for CSV recording.
scenario_alignment_rules: Physical simulation time must strictly follow physical_scenario_time for event triggers (0.0s and 0.23s).
Do not use logical entry_hold_time or statehold values as physical process durations.
Physical responses (compression, rebound, damping decay) must emerge naturally from the physical plant dynamics, not from scheduled logical events.
The 5.0s simulation horizon is an observation stop time, not a physical event.
forbidden_unrelated_concepts: Logical statehold/entry_hold_time values interpreted as physical time delays
Scheduling physical response phases (e.g., max compression, rebound) as external logical events
Unrelated aircraft systems (e.g., flight control, navigation)
